summary: Phase 149O.18B -- HATP Mandatory Evidence Consumption Adapter: bounded implementation phase (Wave B of the 149O.17 plan). Ran the required initial inspection and confirmed baseline: repo clean, origin/main..HEAD=0, 149O.18A completed/complete, HMRC-001 v1.0 VERIFIED WITH NON-BLOCKING FINDINGS -- CONFORMS, HATP production NOT READY, runtime Observed/observe/unavailable. Read the HMRC-001 contract and the 149O.17 implementation plan in full (especially Section 9.2's Wave B module design and Section 10.1's simulation_only provenance discipline), then read the exact production signatures of hatp_evidence_store.py, hatp_signed_evidence.py, hatp_ag_authority.py, human_approval_trusted_provenance.py, rollback_approval_evidence.py, and permission_broker_foundation.py directly, not inferred from any report. Added the sole new production module src/pcae/core/hatp_rollback_consumption.py: an immutable HATPRollbackConsumptionRequest(evidence_id, operation_context) whose site (AG3/AG5) is structurally determined by which of the two existing, unmodified Ag3RollbackApprovalContext/Ag5RollbackApprovalContext types is supplied (an unrecognized type is rejected in __post_init__, before any I/O, alongside HSCE-REQ-056 evidence_id domain validation); the canonical 7-step consumption chain (HATPEvidenceStore.load -> resolve_rollback_approval_evidence_with_hatp, reused entirely unmodified, including its own three-term RAE/HATP/substrate-readiness conjunction -> build_permission_broker_request -> PermissionBroker().evaluate()); and a typed, non-persistent HATPRollbackConsumptionResult(evidence_id, hatp_status, pb_decision, reasons) -- exactly HMRC-REQ-075's four fields, with approval_present deliberately never exposed. Resolved a design question the 149O.17 plan left implicit: HATPEvidenceStore (keyed by the caller's HSCE evidence_id, a digest of the proof's own canonical payload) and RollbackApprovalEvidenceStore (keyed by the RAE Binding's own, independently-generated rae-<uuid>-shaped evidence_id) are two separately-keyed stores -- reusing the caller's single HSCE evidence_id as the RAE lookup key directly would be circular (the HSCE ID is itself a digest that already depends on the proof's binding_id field). The loaded proof's own binding_id field -- which already points at the RAE Binding it self-asserts to attest to -- is used as the RAE lookup key instead; verify_hatp_proof's existing, unmodified operation-identity check independently re-derives the expected binding_id from whichever RAE Binding is actually resolved at that key and compares it back against this same proof field, so this is never a caller-controllable or self-certifying pointer. Implemented two production entrypoints differing only in a hardcoded, non-caller-supplied simulation_only value (evaluate_for_real_effect always False; evaluate_for_advisory always True), matching signature exactly (request, root) on both, with no provider/trust-store/evidence-store/approval-present/raw-proof override parameter anywhere on either (F-2 closure, mirroring hatp_ag_authority.py's own dependency-resolution pattern) -- neither entrypoint is reachable from any real production caller yet. hatp_ag_authority.py, hatp_mandatory_cutover.py, and every other existing HATP/RAE/PB module remain completely unmodified; the new module imports none of hatp_mandatory_cutover.py, agent.py, commands/agent.py, or cli.py (AST-confirmed). Authored 69 new tests across two files (34 in tests/test_hatp_rollback_consumption.py, using a hand-constructed fixture harness mirroring 149O.4's own no-imported-fixtures-across-phase-boundaries convention -- a genuine HATPSignedEvidenceEnvelope paired with a hand-authored RollbackApprovalBinding under its own RAE key, proof binding_id pointing at that key; 35 in tests/test_phase_149o_18b_hatp_mandatory_evidence_consumption_adapter.py covering the production-file allowlist, contract byte-identity, 18A module byte-identity, AST-based dependency-closure/no-effect/no-cutover-write checks, and MC-14 structural truthfulness), both added to Fast Green. Confirmed the full valid HATP/RAE chain (genuine proof, genuine matching Binding) reaches hatp_status=VALID but PB still denies on this deployment because substrate readiness is never operational without real attached hardware -- the same finding 149O.4/149O.5 established one layer down at the RAE/HATP-integration layer, now independently reproduced one layer up through this new adapter, not merely assumed. Proved the ALLOW-path wiring itself (never HATP production readiness) via a deterministic, non-production-reachable substitution of the RAE/HATP engine's own return value one layer below the real PermissionBroker().evaluate() call, per the 149O.17 plan's own item-84B guidance -- confirmed the typed result correctly conveys PB ALLOW with zero rollback effect performed. Confirmed evaluate_for_real_effect's truthful simulation_only=False request deterministically resolves PB DENY under current POL-005, unweakened, unworked-around. Ran a full HMRC/HATP/rollback/PB regression sweep and, via a git-stash-based A/B baseline comparison against the pre-phase working tree, independently confirmed every resulting failure is either pre-existing at the 149O.18A baseline and unrelated to this phase (a pre-existing Python-3.9-venv-interpreter-version check; a small set of registration/provenance-forgery findings and a hatp_sign_cli existence check, all pre-existing and unrelated to HATP consumption), or a necessary, well-understood, HMRC-001-wave-sequencing consequence of this phase's required production module now existing (historical no-src-pcae-changed-since-my-own-entry-commit snapshot assertions in eight older phase-verification test files, plus this phase's own not-yet-committed pre-commit-state test) -- no AG3/AG5/rollback/Permission-Broker behavioral regression was found. VERDICT: HATP MANDATORY EVIDENCE CONSUMPTION ADAPTER: IMPLEMENTED -- READY FOR 149O.18C. No AG3/AG5 effect-boundary integration, no CLI plumbing, no cutover-mode dependency, no legacy-authority change, no Permission Broker change, and no rollback effect was performed by this adapter. HMRC-001 v1.0 and all six upstream contracts remain byte-unchanged; hatp_mandatory_cutover.py (149O.18A) remains byte-unchanged. B-149O-1..4 remain INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED AT HATP-GATED AUTHORITY BOUNDARY -- SYSTEM EXECUTION CLOSURE DEFERRED. HATP production remains NOT READY. Runtime remains Observed / observe / unavailable. Recommended next phase: 149O.18C -- AG3 Mandatory Consumption Integration.

validation_results.name: rae_lookup_key_design_resolved
validation_results.result: Identified and resolved a genuine architectural gap the 149O.17 plan's prose did not spell out: HATPEvidenceStore and RollbackApprovalEvidenceStore are independently-keyed stores, so the caller's single HSCE evidence_id cannot double as the RAE Binding lookup key without circularity. The adapter derives the RAE lookup key from the loaded proof's own binding_id field instead -- verify_hatp_proof's existing, unmodified operation-identity check independently re-derives and cross-checks the expected binding_id from whichever RAE Binding is actually resolved, so this is never a caller-controllable pointer. Confirmed via a hand-constructed deterministic fixture reaching hatp_status=VALID through the full, unmodified RAE/HATP engine.
